definitions.explanation: The handheld part of a telephone containing the mouthpiece and earpiece, or a portable communication device held in the hand.

examples.japanese: ハンドセット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
ハンドセット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{通話|つうわ}→通話：14369_tsuuwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
examples.english: When you put down the handset, the call ends.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{電話機|でんわき}→電話機：22854_denwaki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ハンドセット⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦コード→コード：00241_koodo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分離|ぶんり}できる→分離する：22369_bunrisuru⟧。
examples.english: On this telephone, the handset can be detached from the cord.

notes:
A loanword from English "handset," referring to the part of a telephone you hold to your ear and mouth. In technical and telecom contexts it can also refer to a mobile device as a whole.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ハンドセット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to pick up the handset
- ハンドセット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to hang up the handset
- コードレスハンドセット: a cordless handset

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{受話器|じゅわき}→受話器：15742_juwaki⟧: telephone receiver — the common native term for the same part
- {子機|こき}: cordless handset (extension) — the portable unit of a cordless phone
